title: How To Build An AI Brain (Free Claude Code Setup)
description:
Comment "BRAIN" and I'll send you the free 10-minute setup.

Your AI is dumb because it knows nothing about you. Same model, same generic answers as everyone else. Building an AI brain fixes that in 10 minutes.

I use Obsidian connected to Claude Code. Claude reads my notes, my journal, my goals, even my groceries before it answers a single question. The output gets night and day better.

3 steps to build your own:
1. Download Obsidian for free
2. Have Claude Code set up the vault for you
3. Connect a personal dashboard that feeds it your real life

Your AI knows you for you, not a generic version of you.

#claudecode #ai #claude
